goal: Evolve a redesigned typed-path utility off evaluation, freeze one configuration, then score a held-out matched-budget comparison for MDPI Information.

seen_exclusion.decision: No registry-absent lawful public series is used. The 15-test run is held-out-for-this-revision, not unseen confirmatory. The 7-series post-access pilot is not reused as an eval corpus for this revision.

path_utility_family.historical: minmax of raw qualified-path deletion loss C_raw (published v0.3 term)
path_utility_family.end_stage: minmax(C_raw * stage_weight) with impact/mitigation 1.5, propagation 1.0, cause/trigger 0.75, abstention 0.25

weight_rule: For path_weight a>0 set path=a on the no-path base then renormalize all five channels to sum to 1. Redundancy penalty stays 0.50. Reservation on. Typed graph on. Complete-ranking word budget with skip-if-unfit.

textrank.selection: complete ranking by pagerank then skip-if-unfit word budget; no role reservation

freeze_rule: Among variants with path_weight>0, maximize ((mean ROUGE-L at 110)+(mean ROUGE-L at 260))/2 on the 12-dev split; ties: higher 260, then higher 110, then lower mean redundancy, then lexicographically earlier utility name, then smaller path_weight. No-path is a development reference, not a freeze candidate. The frozen variant is scored on the 15-test even if it loses to no-path on development.
overwrite: A sealed run directory with EVALUATION.json or SEALED marker must not be overwritten.
claims_forbidden: system superiority unless the paper confirmatory bar is met
